result.summary: Found 1 major visually broken element with overlapping/garbled delivery text under Tokumaru Ramen Bar, plus a minor styling inconsistency in favorite icons.

issues.description: Delivery metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is garbled/overlapping, reading as '25-30rdelivery' instead of separate time and delivery info
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout of the restaurant metadata row to prevent text overlap so delivery time, fee and cuisine display clearly on separate, non-overlapping elements

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru card shows a plain white outline with no background while the pizza card below shows a heart inside a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style with the same background, size and contrast across all cards
